# Conditional ordinary-nearest-neighbor synthesis of the literal L4 joint Hamiltonian

This source assembly preserves the complete accepted finite synthesis argument for the full physical Hamiltonian `H=lambda N_full+B`, including its scalar, unused link level, cyclic wrap and off-code pair branches. It gives an explicitly scheduled finite ordinary-nearest-neighbor implementation with an all-input, arbitrary-reference error bound. The controls, addressability, drift removal or priced residual, effective coefficient data, timing and calibration remain supplied.

**Current status.** Root conditionally accepted the underlying source at **2026-10-14T11:29:04.661633Z** under `7c5a3348519d3153d8ab2e6ddf4863c8bb9c04627685f631375a235cd6a24af9`, following complete root and separate source-exposed review. The original proof is unchanged at SHA256 `12cba56f7e62e4e9d8b55682d1110fb8764754a49ffb51365423174e28a61255`, 39,937 bytes and 373 lines. Its provisional, pending-review, exposure and checkpoint statements are historical source records. This wrapper, extraction and complete evidence assembly were conditionally accepted under 83dcb1b758e96a507ed392243072a5869e7dc66e58b97be5d61542ead274d6e2 after root review 6bc5bfdbbbab83d43ddc7f164cc3403f0f05d1f92f2c40ca63a3e3ff29a438dd. This new publication rendering and driver require separate exact root acceptance. No canonical integration, publication driver, graph execution, retained status or audit verdict is authorized or asserted here.

## Literal operator, supplied controls and two scientific parents

The fixed model uses the parent's L4 coarse torus, six matter modes per coarse cell, 960 matter-edge factors and 192 two-factor links: 1,344 active factors. The same representatives occupy an ordinary `64 x 64 x 64` open box for control routing. A periodic seam in the target operator is not a free ordinary-NN edge. All other box factors may be dirty and entangled with the active input and an arbitrary passive reference.

The full penalty has 704 signed local-cycle projectors, 192 unused-link projectors and 64 Gauss squares. It does **not** add three Wilson projectors. Its scalar `688 I` remains in `N_full`. The dynamical part retains the parent's allowed intracell, electric and plaquette terms and the bare stream `i A(C-C†)` with `C=U+|-1><+1|+|11><11|`. No restriction to the charged compression is made in the synthesis theorem. The total Hamiltonian is Hermitian; this statement adds no positivity assertion.

There are exactly two direct scientific parents, the [joint interface](JOINT_EVEN_MATTER_FINITE_LINK_INTERFACE_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md) and [finite penalty](FINITE_GAUSS_PENALTY_RECOVERY_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md), with these current complete canonical bodies:

| Canonical note and SHA256 | Actual role |
| --- | --- |
| `docs/JOINT_EVEN_MATTER_FINITE_LINK_INTERFACE_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md`, `212a94bb9cbd2a5d53a227d7d8103b7eca5cc018ec8bb5ca2c86c0ca660c8aef` | Literal graph, ordering, signed A/B/F convention, four-state link extension, nonstream coefficient family and coordinates. Its full unchanged `34cbe355c3cd643e3eb3233560fa53259b5803fa1114e4c8eedabbb40475dbca` body is uniquely extracted and archived. |
| `docs/FINITE_GAUSS_PENALTY_RECOVERY_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md`, `437f2f4e94aa93038173cd138c5f6b9ad4ebdc4fbc7416428cfa13192c9e4ff4` | Literal full penalty and bare B, scalar and off-code terms, plus the separately conditional initial-K finite-penalty comparison. Its complete unchanged primary body `bb2817d3ac9a2f986dd1abcd423331214195f4f627601949f74ca75af669bc14` is uniquely extracted and archived. |

`DEPENDENCIES.json` and `PARENT_BODY_MAP.json` bind the precise roles, original paths, complete raw bodies and canonical byte/line intervals. The stronger resolved per-site penalty prices in the second parent's other bodies are not substituted for this compiler's unaggregated global coefficient sum. Parent status/proposed-publication paragraphs retain their own historical context. This packet does not refresh Git refs or infer a new publication event from file existence.

[Cycle 870 returned routing](OPENREFERENCE_CUBIC_RECURRENT_PHYSICAL_M2_MATTER_COMPILER_CYCLE870_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-08-02.md) and [Cycle 883 return](RECURRENT_ENCODE_UPDATE_DECODE_SANDWICH_CYCLE883_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-08-03.md), with the bounded next-route screen, supply limited overlap/provenance attribution. These two attribution citations are graph edges but not mathematical theorem imports; the publication has four actual canonical citations and exactly two mathematical parents. Generic Pauli rotations, product formulas and returned routing are prior machinery; the complete appended proof derives the finite identities it uses. Neither those notes' different compiler constants nor neutral preparation, binary admission, local/geometric-time recovery, an always-on-control candidate or branch ancestry supplies another theorem. The expected future scientific dependency count is two; no graph was executed and no future graph artifact is accepted here.

The operating alphabet supplies serial supported H, S/S†, CNOT and ordinary SWAP pulses, signed Z rotations and a separately priced identity pulse for literal scalar phase. Addressed one-site or ordinary-NN two-site pulse Hamiltonians obey the stated norm cap. The matrix-exponential phases are explicit: rotations use `exp(-i theta Z)`, not a half angle. Forward routes, a central endpoint operation and exact reverse routes implement tensor-factor conjugation, returning arbitrary dirty transit and its correlations. This is an all-vector operator identity, not a clean-ancilla or classical-token assumption.

## Error and resource statement retained from the proof

For the unaggregated Pauli presentation, the penalty's nonidentity absolute coefficient sum is `a=5392 lambda`, and `b_P<=8832 J` bounds the nonidentity dynamical sum. All penalty Pauli terms commute. For r first-order slices, the full-vector error is at most `t^2(2 a b_P+b_P^2)/(2r)`, and the complete active/transit/reference trace error is at most `min(2,t^2(2 a b_P+b_P^2)/r)`. The scalar contributes no splitting error and is implemented explicitly. These bounds require neither an initial code state nor a spectral gap. Negative simulated times use the displayed signed pulses and absolute-time bounds.

The source gives a finite compiler specification for supplied effective coefficient arrays. It uses at most 802,688 unaggregated nonidentity Pauli slots, arity at most 28, ordinary routes of length at most 189 and at most 20,470 fixed basis/routing pulses per slot. It prices each slot's angle pulse, the scalar pulse, total control time, coefficient and simulated-time approximation, primitive calibration and full-box residual drift. The combined trace ledger remains equation (22) of the unchanged proof. Correct endpoint error alone does not establish physical support or norm-cap compliance; those remain separate premises. Simulated time and laboratory schedule duration are distinct.

The implementation assumes drift removal before the schedule, or includes the actual residual through `2 integral ||R(s)|| ds`. An arbitrary high-arity compensator is not an allowed unpriced NN pulse. The separately drafted always-on-control result is outside this accepted source and is not imported to remove that premise.

For initial states supported on the separately supplied K sector, the source permits adding its synthesis error to the inherited finite-penalty recovery error, under the latter's actual positive-lambda and strong-penalty hypotheses. This optional comparison concerns the same full output, including escaped amplitude and arbitrary passive references. It does not extend recovery to arbitrary initial inputs, supply K/Wilson preparation, replace full-space gap 1 with a reducing-space gap 2 without the reducing premise, or remove finite-lambda virtual corrections.

## Emitted artifacts and finite prescriptions

| Artifact or quantity | Exact status |
| --- | --- |
| 802,688-record Pauli ledger | Actually emitted; full 4,388,398-byte gzip is preserved unchanged at `6963d3bf74a2c73d2757b899241c224b80c439350687599527cb8a8f1cb35f6b`. Its previously checked 94,227,735-byte decompressed identity is retained; assembly does not regenerate or recompute the ledger. |
| Rational constant-coefficient parameter fixture | Actually emitted, with scalar `26048/35`, r=68075 and the recorded coefficient/count/time prescription. This is one fixture, not an executed arbitrary-array front end. |
| Route and coordinate inventories | Actually emitted and identity-bound. The author census is 39,455 factors, 38,111 dirty transit factors, maximum route length 184, and 526,139,856 fixed pulses per slice. The separate review did not repeat the entire census; conservative analytic bounds remain sufficient. |
| Selected macro | One actual 27-pulse word was emitted and checked in the author's six-qubit matrix control. |
| Full 35,871,613,682,801-pulse schedule | Finite macro/repeat prescription only. It was neither expanded nor executed. The displayed `[35816970697200*pi+76024/875]/J_c` is a sufficient schedule-time bound, not observed hardware time. |
| Strong-penalty recovery in the fixture | Not demonstrated: its lambda=1 is outside the stated sufficient recovery regime. Successful literal compilation does not alter that limitation. |

## Evidence, exposure and limits

The complete author archive contains all 28 original files: proof, four programs, all four genuine run receipts and complete raw streams, the full Pauli gzip, fixture, macro, source exposure and failure/limit records. All 54 separate-review files are preserved, including its own exact author copy, five premise copies, pre-exposure assessment, selected records, one new scientific run and one source-only identity run. The six root-review files, both actual root binding executions with their full streams and recorder, and current acceptance are also preserved.

The separate worker sealed obligations at 11:00:58.452660Z before first opening candidate sources at 11:01:19.707786Z. Its brief had already disclosed the target and two headline counts. The later checker was written after complete source exposure, in the same campaign/model family. It separately specified one seam bare-stream block, one Gauss square and small phase-exact pulse matrices. It used 159 selected ledger rows, with exact sign/wrap/scalar discriminators and floating small-gate diagnostics. It did not independently reconstruct all 802,688 rows or the complete route census. Full source review and algebraic proofs supply the broader conclusion; neither hashes nor repeated success lines do so.

Wrong Y basis, deleted return SWAP, half-angle, wrap omission, raw-to-charged substitution, omitted plaquette adjoint, wrong seam orientation, incoming-link sign and scalar controls remain unchanged. The original near-zero Choi cancellation diagnostic is retained with its correct numerical limitation. Scalar omission is a vector/coherent-invocation failure; the unconditional density channel is unchanged. The navigation-regex and truncated-display records retain their actual missing metadata and subsequent read recovery. No failure has been replaced with invented output.

This is a finite, supplied, scheduled synthesis contract. It proves no native/static NN Hamiltonian identification, autonomy, hardware calibration, energy/fuel/clock identification, preparation, physical measurement apparatus, efficiency or optimality, thermodynamic/all-volume result, odd/full-Fock access, continuum or photon claim. The accepted geometric assembly is only the procedural packaging pattern. Source assembly acceptance, review and execution of this new canonical publication package, and independent retained audit remain distinct actions owned by root. All original bodies are unchanged; no editable prompt, axiom, checkpoint or Git state was altered.
